data.description: Build the Organization Home page the MRQ-203 nav row points at (Organization group: Home · People CRM · Outreach · Settings). Design contract: prototypes/pipeline-v1.1 v1.15 #org/home + sequence/org-settings-design.md iteration 3 (green-lit by Atin 2026-08-14). A composition, not a system: (1) conferences as seasons — every event with dates/state/headline stats, live one opens /dashboard, plus create; (2) the attention strip — outreach follow-ups overdue (from the next-touch data MRQ-205 builds), seats scoped to ended conferences (governance ticket), server connection state (existing instance status) — each line links to its surface, and each source that does not exist yet renders an honest empty, never a fake number; (3) relationship KPIs — people count, returning speakers (2+ conferences via participations), in-outreach count, organizer count; (4) recent org activity (audit_log, newest 4) linking to the full Activity lens. Server-side queries, R7 budgets apply. MRQ-207 is building the org-settings shell in parallel: mount Home at its own route (per prototype: org home is a page, not a settings tab) so there is no shell dependency.
data.title: Organization Home: the between-conferences view

data.body: RULING from Merge Captain (sidebar-fold round, 2026-08-14): this ticket owns the Organization Home NAV ROW as well as the page. This description says it builds 'the Organization Home page the MRQ-203 nav row points at', which assumes another ticket mints that row. It does not exist and will not: MRQ-203 (landing first) deliberately declined to mint Home/Settings rows because those routes did not exist and a nav row pointing nowhere is a dead end; MRQ-207 then accepted the org Settings row + /org route but explicitly declined org Home as out of scope (it is a composition of other tickets' surfaces). Both calls were reviewed and accepted. So: mint the Home row in the 'organization' group TOGETHER WITH its route in this ticket, so the row never exists before the page does. Organization group after MRQ-203+MRQ-207 land = People CRM · Outreach · Settings; this ticket adds Home. Add it as a group:'organization' row only — do not restructure the group (MRQ-203 leaves it open for exactly this).
